conclusion: Both split modes regress equally (mode1 17.56, mode2 17.63/19.53 vs mode0 21.24): the front-macro state duplication of mode 2 is NOT the main cost
Front loses ~50% of its time in Drain (2180/s at ~232 us) waiting on a saturated back
